motivation_from_completed_diagnostics.interpretation: Amplitude gauge explains the catastrophic collapse, but globally assigning one prototype index to every neighborhood token still destroys canonical context.

fixed_method.mode_combination: measure modes separately before any combination

sentinel.protocol: frozen fixed-0.6, target-blind Otsu3, AP/oracle/margin diagnostic
sentinel.continue_rule: Only investigate a parameter-free mode distribution readout if at least one anchor-mode branch improves a latent ranking metric over Field-C without catastrophic fixed/adaptive regression.
sentinel.stop_rule: Do not expand to other LERF scenes when both anchor modes are dominated by Field-C on AP, oracle IoU, fixed mIoU, and Otsu mIoU.
